Don't pay the 15 if you just want to try the app!

reviews.title: Pay before you try
reviews.text: Wanted to see what this really does that my Ford app doesn’t. However you can’t get a feel for it without paying. I selected monthly option knowing I could cancel any time. Turns out this does nothing I don’t already have access to on my Ford app. Not worth keeping for me. Went to cancel and find it signed me up for the $49 one time fee AND some $9.99 a month subscription. That doesn’t make me happy. Have requested a full refund. Buyer beware.
